production.method: OpenAI image generation, spacing revision through image generation; copied byte exactly without pixel editing

firstLayout.reasonRejected: Connected tree silhouettes crossed the half-canvas atlas boundaries.

brief: Four original dead-tree silhouettes: stout split, thin leaning, hollow low pollard, narrow forked. Ash/umber/chalk, upper-left light, transparent background, tree roots aligned by explicit atlas pivots. Preserve existing game rules and separate living species and legacy fallback share.
pixelInputs: Only the generated first atlas was supplied to its spacing edit. No reference game artwork was used as image input.
atlasNote: Frame bounds use visible alpha>16 and4px padding. Sub-visible alpha noise outside the drawing bounds is excluded by the texture rectangle; PNG bytes remain unchanged.

integrationReview: First preliminary browser run loaded the atlas but preserved original_dead_tree as a custom sprite. PNG review found the new resources were not used. Default resolved sprite priority was corrected and tested through loadDb.
